rv.q: The Roundabout Theater Co., the gallant keeper of the Shavian flame in Gotham for some time, harnesses a creditable amount of the play’s intellectual — and comic — dynamite in its nicely upholstered Broadway revival of Shaw’s 1905 masterwork.
It is a credit to Mr. Sullivan that the production succeeds in making it both.

cn.t: Shaw's century-old masterwork retains its intellectual force in this well-crafted Broadway revival, with Sullivan's nuanced direction orchestrating the dense dialectical comedy into a harmonious ensemble piece.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
